He'd just checked the Plains depots on "Tobias's dealer account". That message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks, so the link is mine. I based it on a GBrain note saying Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account until it changed hands on Jan 5, 2026.

The shared file area has no account files I can see, so I couldn't find the ticket's current status. I suggested she ask Tobias for the latest before her customer call.
